text: Added a complete DE/EN interface, streamlined the layout for faster contact editing and copying, and removed the unused messaging module (v1.6.x).
Refined the responsive layout, settings sidebar controls and tablet workflow for a smoother teleprompter experience (v1.3.7).
New browser-based audio utility for format conversion and transcription, with local processing and no server upload required (v1.5).
New QR utility for URLs, email, WhatsApp, SMS, Wi-Fi, vCard contacts and SEPA payment codes (v1.0.1).
Improved print layout options with portrait/landscape switching and a more flexible zoom control.
Enhanced the convention note workflow with local autosave, import/export backups and print-friendly notes.
The imported speaker database version is now detected and displayed directly from the CSV filename (v2.1.5).
Refined the dashboard branding with a clearer NOVAplan header, company identity and consistent footer presentation.
